Title: 2026-02-20 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Balance & bug fixes for Muradin, Murky, Deathwing, and Tyrande, plus Hanamura Temple and Braxis Holdout fixes.
Highlights: Balance & bug fixes for Muradin, Murky, Deathwing, and Tyrande, plus Hanamura Temple and Braxis Holdout fixes.
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Braxis Holdout ===
  • Fixed an issue that caused terrain to be rendered incorrectly.

=== Battlegrounds: Hanamura Temple ===
  • The Samurai Sentinel camp is now properly displayed with a Bruiser icon.

=== Heroes: Deathwing ===
  • Base — Incinerate [W]: Cooldown increased from 6 seconds to 7 seconds.
  • Level 7 — Death Drop: Duration of Spell Armor decreased from 6 seconds to 4 seconds.
  • Base — Form Swap: AI can no longer use the removed Form Swap ability.

=== Heroes: Gul'dan ===
  • Level 16 — Ruinous Affliction: Fixed an issue causing bonus damage on the 3rd and 5th hit instead of the 3rd and 6th hit.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
  • Base — Frostbite [Trait]: Fixed an issue causing Ice Block to show the wrong cooldown in the tooltip, and fixed an issue allowing Ice Cold to move through pathing blockers and stationary targets.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
  • Base — Storm Bolt [Q]: Quest requirements reduced from 50/200 to 40/160.
  • Level 1 — Give 'Em The Axe: Bonus damage reduced from 50% to 40%.
  • Level 4 — Sledgehammer: Now also reduces the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 1.5 seconds.
  • Level 7 — Perfect Storm: Internal cooldown reduced from 10 seconds to 8.5 seconds, and now also restores 25 Mana on reset.
  • Level 13 — Healing Static: Heal per Hero hit increased from 5% to 6%.
  • Base — Dwarf Toss [E]: Fixed an issue that caused Dwarf Toss to go on cooldown when used on invalid terrain.
  • Level 1 — Dwarf Block: Can no longer stack beyond 3 charges.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
  • Base — Spawn Egg [D]: Revive Shield duration increased from 10 seconds to 15 seconds.
  • Level 10 — March of the Murlocs: Cooldown reduced from 110 seconds to 100 seconds.
  • Level 13 — Egg Shell: Shield increased from 35% to 50% of Murky's Health, and now lasts until destroyed.
  • Level 20 — Never-Ending March: Will now last a minimum of 7 seconds, even if stopped.
  • Level 20 talents have been rearranged to match skill order.
  • Murky will no longer revive faster than intended.
  • Base — Pufferfish [W]: Puffed Up will now display first in the Buff Bar; fixed an issue causing Murky to lose his increased size after death.
  • Base — Spawn Egg [D]: Fixed an issue causing Murky to respawn faster than intended.
  • Level 1 — Shell Game: Now shows the Trait button for the talent instead of an Active button.
  • Level 20 — Faster Fish: Now also causes the Pufferfish animation to play faster, and shows the W button instead of the Trait button.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
  • Level 20 — Elemental Conduit: Fixed shield refresh not resetting to 5 seconds and fixed refresh targeting searching around hit targets instead of Rehgar's location.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
  • Level 1 — Echo of the Elements: Fixed bounces hitting cloaked targets.
  • Level 7 — Rolling Thunder: Damage now displays as a crit.
  • Level 16 — Alpha Wolf: Damage now displays as a crit.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
  • Base — Lunar Flare [E]: Mythic reward requirements reduced from 45 hits to 40 hits.
  • Level 7 — Lost Soul: Extra 10% damage bonus removed.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
  • Base — Infested Drop [E]: Fixed Roach melee attacks launching missiles instead of direct hits, and fixed Roaches not displaying properly in death recap.
